example: Leemos un cuento en el sillón.
exampleTranslation: Let's read a story on the sofa.

example: Cuidado con la esquina de la mesa ratona.
exampleTranslation: Careful with the corner of the coffee table.

example: Los cuentos van en el estante de abajo.
exampleTranslation: The storybooks go on the bottom shelf.

example: Prendo la lámpara, que ya está oscuro.
exampleTranslation: I'll switch the lamp on, it's getting dark.

example: Jugamos en la alfombra, que es blandita.
exampleTranslation: Let's play on the rug, it's nice and soft.

example: Te pongo un almohadón atrás para que no te caigas.
exampleTranslation: I'll put a cushion behind you so you don't topple over.

example: ¿Quieres saltar en la cama de mamá?
exampleTranslation: Do you want to jump on Mum's bed?

example: Tu ropa está en el placard.
exampleTranslation: Your clothes are in the wardrobe.

example: Te cambio arriba de la cómoda.
exampleTranslation: I'll change you on top of the chest of drawers.

example: El monitor está en la mesita de luz.
exampleTranslation: The monitor is on the bedside table.

example: No saltes en el colchón, que te caes.
exampleTranslation: Don't jump on the mattress, you'll fall.

example: Vamos a la mesa, que está la comida.
exampleTranslation: Come to the table, the food's ready.

example: Las galletitas están arriba, en la alacena.
exampleTranslation: The biscuits are up in the cupboard.

example: No toques la mesada, que hay un cuchillo.
exampleTranslation: Don't touch the worktop, there's a knife on it.
The bath's ready, in you go!

example: No, el inodoro no es para jugar.
exampleTranslation: No, the toilet isn't for playing with.
